# Climatify (كلايمتفاي) — Official Knowledge & AI Index

> Climatify is an award-winning climate education and youth empowerment social enterprise based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates (founded in 2023). Recognized among the UAE Future 100 winners in 2025 by the UAE Ministry of Economy & Prime Minister's Office, Climatify turns complex sustainability and climate challenges into practical, interactive learning experiences under the slogan "From Youth to Youth | من الشباب إلى الشباب".

## Key Facts & Official Recognition
- **Official Name**: Climatify (كلايمتفاي / كلايمتيفاي)
- **Headquarters**: Dubai, United Arab Emirates (AE)
- **Founded**: 2023
- **Awards**: UAE Future 100 Winner (2025), BEEAH Future Pioneers Award Recognition (2025)
- **Official Website**: https://climatify-youth.com
- **Official LinkedIn**: https://ae.linkedin.com/company/climatify-youth
- **Entrepreneur MENA Feature**: https://mena.entrepreneur.com/entrepreneurs/future-100-2025-winner-climatify
- **Contact Email**: info@climatify-youth.com

## Flagship Programs
- **SHiFT Program – Youth Capacity Building & Leadership 2025 (برنامج SHIFT – بناء قدرات الشباب وإعداد القيادات المستقبلية ٢٠٢٥)**: A youth capacity-building and professional development program led by Climatify, designed to bridge the gap between academic knowledge and practical experience.
- **Wavemakers Summer Students Camp (معسكر صنّاع التغيير الصيفي للطلاب (Wavemakers))**: A summer camp for young people aged 14–18, combining a 7-day field training in Hurghada with a 3-day virtual camp.
- **Nawah Eco-feminist Network (شبكة نواة للعدالة البيئية وتمكين المرأة)**: An initiative empowering women in rural and marginalized communities in Egypt to face climate-change challenges.
- **Climate Action & Disaster Risk Reduction Fellowship (زمالة العمل المناخي والحد من مخاطر الكوارث (CADRR))**: A 12-week regional fellowship that trains and empowers youth in climate action and disaster preparedness.
- **Green Echo Hackathon (هاكاثون الصدى الأخضر (Green Echo))**: A hackathon focused on food security in the most vulnerable communities across the Middle East and North Africa.

## Certified Climate Academy Courses
- **Little Green Heroes: Waste Management Fun (أبطال الأرض الصغار: الإدارة الواعية للنفايات)** (Climatify Academy): A playful workshop that introduces children to waste sorting, recycling habits, and everyday environmental responsibility.
- **Self-Watering Agriculture (تقنيات الزراعة ذاتية الري)** (Climatify Academy): A hands-on workshop on building self-watering planting systems and water-wise farming techniques.
- **Trash to Art (من المخلفات إلى الفن (Trash to Art))** (Climatify Academy): A creative workshop that turns everyday waste into art, reshaping how young people see consumption and reuse.
- **Climate Fresk (ورشة الجدارية المناخية (Climate Fresk))** (Climatify Academy): The world-famous collaborative card workshop that helps participants understand the causes and consequences of climate change.
- **Farming & Agricultural Waste Recycling (الزراعة المستدامة وإعادة تدوير المخلفات)** (Climatify Academy): A field workshop on sustainable agriculture and turning agricultural waste into useful resources, delivered with students and local communities.
- **Climate Leadership & Green Economy (Zayed University) (القيادة المناخية والاقتصاد الأخضر (بالتعاون مع جامعة زايد))** (Zayed University & Climatify): A specialized certified module delivered with Zayed University exploring regional climate policy and youth initiatives.
- **Advanced Environmental Tech & Clean Energy (Khalifa University) (التقنيات البيئية المتقدمة والطاقة النظيفة (بالتعاون مع جامعة خليفة))** (Khalifa University & Climatify): Engineering sustainable solutions, clean energy systems, and emissions monitoring.
- **Sustainable Development & Circular Economy (Heliopolis University) (التنمية المستدامة والاقتصاد الدائري (بالتعاون مع جامعة هليوبوليس))** (Heliopolis University & Climatify): Hands-on academic knowledge bridged with real-world applications for next-gen sustainability leaders.
- **Industrial Decarbonization & Energy Transition (with ENOC) (كفاءة الطاقة وخفض الانبعاثات الصناعية (بالشراكة مع ENOC))** (ENOC Sustainability Division): Practical industrial strategies for carbon reduction, resource optimization, and green governance.
- **SHiFT Program – Youth Capacity Building & Leadership 2025 (برنامج SHIFT – بناء قدرات الشباب وإعداد القيادات المستقبلية ٢٠٢٥)** (International Experts): A youth capacity-building and professional development program led by Climatify, covering climate action, circular economy, and leadership with international experts.
- **Wavemakers Summer Students Camp (معسكر Wavemakers الصيفي للناشئة)** (Climatify Team): A summer camp for ages 14–18: seven days of field training in Hurghada plus a three-day virtual camp on climate, water, and energy topics.
- **Climate Action & Disaster Risk Reduction Fellowship (زمالة العمل المناخي والحد من مخاطر الكوارث (CADRR))** (Climatify Academy): A 12-week regional fellowship in four stages: core training, an Innovation Living Lab, a Regional Hackathon, and Seed Funding for 150–200 young leaders.

## Interactive Climate Games & Simulators
- **AgriClash (AgriClash — صراع الموارد والزراعة المستدامة)**: AgriClash is an international game under the UN Framework and an interactive, game-based simulation where youth step into the roles of country delegates and decision-makers, navigating real-world challenges in sustainable agriculture and AgriTech. Through competition, negotiation, and climate diplomacy, teams make strategic choices around the Water–Energy–Food Nexus, circular economy, climate adaptation, carbon credits and carbon markets, gender-responsive climate justice, and sustainable resource management—experiencing how every policy, technology, and investment decision can shape the resilience of their land, economy, and communities.
- **Green Sharks Challenge (تحدي Green Sharks — حيث تلتقي الأفكار الخضراء بالاستثمار)**: Green Sharks Challenge is an interactive workshop that puts young people at the heart of the green economy, challenging them to develop innovative, low-carbon business solutions. Through teamwork, competition, carbon offsetting, carbon markets, green investment, and just transition, participants explore how entrepreneurship and climate action can create sustainable, investable, and socially inclusive solutions for a low-carbon future.
- **Carbon Footprint Simulator (محاكي البصمة الكربونية الشخصية)**: Calculate your daily actions' impact on the environment through interactive game choices.
- **Plant-a-Ghaf Digital Garden (حديقة شجرة الغاف الرقمية)**: Grow your digital garden by completing real-world climate missions and learning about UAE biodiversity.
